results.question: From which ports was the Pharaon coming when it arrived at Marseilles?
What illness did Captain Leclere fall ill with after the Pharaon left Naples?
What number was Edmond Dantès known by in the Château d’If?
What is the address of the Count of Monte Cristo’s house in Paris?
At what address is the Count’s country house in Auteuil?
results.expected_answer: No. 28, Rue de la Fontaine, at Auteuil.

results.question: What kind of fits did Abbé Faria suffer from in prison?
Where did Luigi Vampa’s bandits hold Albert de Morcerf in Rome?
results.expected_answer: In the catacombs of Saint Sebastian.

results.question: How much did the bandits ask Danglars to pay for a fowl?
Who are Haydée’s parents?
results.expected_answer: Ali Pasha (Ali Tepelini), pasha of Yanina, and Vasiliki.

results.question: In which two words is all human wisdom summed up, according to the count?
How much was the diamond that the abbé showed Caderousse worth?
What trick did the supercargo use so that nobody would recognise his handwriting on the anonymous letter?
results.expected_answer: He wrote with his left hand.

results.question: What was tied to the hero’s feet when the jailers threw him from the fortress into the sea?
Which poison did the count say a person could get used to by taking a slightly bigger dose every day?
Where was the young man who passed himself off as the son of an Italian major really born?
results.expected_answer: At Auteuil, in No. 28, Rue de la Fontaine.

results.question: What false news, printed after a telegraph message, made the banker sell his Spanish bonds?
results.expected_answer: That Don Carlos had escaped from Bourges and returned to Spain.

results.question: What drug did the host of the hidden grotto offer Franz after dinner?
In which exact spot did the cardinal’s will say the treasure was hidden?
results.expected_answer: In the farthest angle of the second opening (cave).

results.question: Where did La Réserve buy the paper the waiter brought, and what watermark did it have?
results.expected_answer: From the stationer Mère Brigaud in the Rue de Rome; the watermark is a swallow.

results.question: What was the very first entry in Bertuccio’s expense ledger?
results.expected_answer: 412 francs paid to the glazier Théophile Barrat for the windows of the house at Auteuil.

results.question: Who engraved the seal that Danglars pressed into the denunciation, and where had Danglars taken it from?
results.expected_answer: Joseph Lanfrey, an engraver of Toulon, cut it in 1811; Danglars took it from the captain’s desk on board the Pharaon.

results.question: To whom did Danglars hand the denunciation after writing it, and what postmark did the letter bear?
results.expected_answer: To Fernand; the postmark was Marseilles, 27th February, delivery 6 o’clock P.M.

results.question: What name was the child buried alive at Auteuil given by the steward’s sister-in-law, and who was his real father?
On what date did the Pharaon arrive at Marseilles?
What jewel was in the purse that saved Morrel from ruin?
results.expected_answer: A ruby as large as a pigeon’s egg.

results.question: What was the name of Edmond Dantès’s dog?
Who directed the 2002 film adaptation of The Count of Monte Cristo?
In what year did Alexandre Dumas publish the novel?
What was the name of the cook on board the Pharaon?
How many children did Albert de Morcerf have?
Who is the daughter of the pasha that Fernand betrayed and murdered?
results.expected_answer: Haydée (Fernand betrayed Ali Tepelini, pasha of Yanina, and Haydée is his daughter).

results.question: Who is the real father of the man arrested for the murder of Caderousse?
results.expected_answer: Villefort, the procureur (the murderer is Andrea Cavalcanti, born Benedetto).
